retention_rules.canonical_history: Retained for the life of the installation as append-only history; no default erasure/UPDATE/DELETE path. Corrections append. Raw-content expiry does not remove typed facts. Accidental canonical personal data needs an explicit incident/design decision.
retention_rules.installation_operational: Current operational history persists locally until overwritten by its defined operation or installation removal. No general automatic job/credential history purge is implemented; never describe this as raw-evidence 90-day retention.
retention_rules.derived_history: Disposable typed acceleration persists until rebuild/replacement; replay authority remains in the journal. Raw original restrictions do not delete numeric state.
retention_rules.evidence_policy: Default 90 days from local receipt; explicit per-source/class policy, permanent shorter revisions and provider ceilings apply. Missing provenance is denied irrespective of receipt clock. Immediate access denial, hourly eligibility and daily orphan cleanup when host runs, audited physical removal. Old archives/copies remain separate.
retention_rules.provider_credential_lifetime: Encrypted credentials persist while the connection exists, including paused/disconnected state; rotation/reconnect replaces material and revokes stale revisions. No automatic provider-side revocation or credential erasure is claimed.
retention_rules.provider_cursor_lifetime: Outer resume cursor persists encrypted for pending/paused/failed/reauthorization jobs; final page or completion removes it. Legacy plaintext positions are discarded/audited during forward migration. No 90-day operational cursor purge claim.
retention_rules.producer_nonce_window: Scoped nonce replay receipt; entries older than ten minutes are removed during subsequent ingestion. No independent timed nonce-cleanup daemon.
retention_rules.request_lifetime: Bounded request memory only; not persisted as this field.
retention_rules.release_lifetime: Nonpersonal format history retained with installation and compatible backup metadata.
retention_rules.host_secret_lifetime: Private key files remain until explicit verified rotation/retirement or installation removal; independently encrypted old backups can retain old keys under their own retention.
retention_rules.owner_secret_copy: Displayed once through a protected channel; owner/client controls any saved external copy. Server retains only verifier.
retention_rules.diagnostics_current: Current implementation: 1,024-entry memory queue, 8-MiB current file plus one rotated file per component. Global 100-MiB/seven-day enforcement, 15-minute debug and full export/overhead gates remain open. Existing mtime-based rotation is not proof of exact seven-day deletion.
retention_rules.backup_generation_policy: Immutable encrypted generations: default latest seven daily and four weekly generations with shared generations; configured host retention applies when destination is available. Copies outside control and unmounted destinations remain unknown, not guaranteed erased.
retention_rules.browser_session: Browser session cookie, or remembered cookie with 30-day maximum age. Server authorization additionally expires after eight hours / 30 days and eight-hour / seven-day idle limits; logout or revocation denies reuse. Browser copies can outlive server validity.
retention_rules.browser_page_memory: Page memory until page unload/replacement; validity additionally follows the associated revocable session.

reader_groups.business_scoped: Authenticated current owner session or read-only named agent in the same workspace via API/MCP; authorized internal API/worker/Rust roles under RLS; OS-authorized host maintenance. Agents cannot mutate/administer.
reader_groups.business_provenance_scoped: Current authorized workspace business readers receive only API/MCP-exposed provenance/cutoffs; internal scoped roles and host maintenance read metadata. Original bytes additionally require retained/accessibility policy.
reader_groups.retained_business_scoped: Current owner or read-only agent only after workspace authorization, retained/accessibility predicate and restore guard; retry worker through guarded evidence read; host maintenance for verification/removal. Expiry is not bypassed by a metadata link.
reader_groups.owner_admin: Current owner session through owner-only routes, authorized scoped internal services and OS-authorized host maintenance; no agent administration read/write endpoint.
reader_groups.authentication_service_and_owner_metadat: Authentication lookup/authorized internal roles and host; owner sees safe principal/name/status metadata, never verifiers or another key. No agent administration endpoint.
reader_groups.runtime_only: Authorized internal runtime roles/host; no direct end-user arbitrary table or filesystem access.
reader_groups.credential_services_only: API connection management, source worker and fenced host verification/rotation; no browser or agent credential/cursor plaintext endpoint. Rust has no data-encryption key mount.
reader_groups.connector_request_memory_only: Active bounded connector request and authorized provider endpoint only, never logs/UI/agent output.
reader_groups.host_only: OS-authorized installation owner and explicitly fenced maintenance; no web/MCP raw filesystem access.
reader_groups.issuing_owner_or_named_client: Protected issuance channel or the explicitly configured named client; plaintext access keys are not shared owner credentials for MCP.
reader_groups.owner_diagnostics: Current owner session or OS-authorized CLI; no read-only agent diagnostics administration and no automatic telemetry.
